content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm currently working with two [product_name] devices connected over a local LAN, and there's an operator display involved. I've developed a valve sequencing program with 35 outputs for a dedusting application. The challenge is to show the output statuses on the operator display. At the moment, I can monitor the first 20 outputs from [product_name] No1, but I'm unsure how to access the outputs from [product_name] No2. Any advice would be appreciated.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. To solve your issue, you need to transfer the output statuses from the second [product_name] device to the first one. Please upload the program files for both devices in a ZIP archive to the forum, and I will prepare a network project to assist you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to monitor output statuses from two connected logic controllers using a single operator display. The main difficulty arises in displaying outputs from the second controller, while the first controller's outputs are already visible. This highlights a common challenge when attempting multi-controller output visualization on a single operator device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to conveniently view all controller output statuses on one operator device, regardless of which controller the outputs originate from.
